Dante. Primeira carta. O advogado disse: Dante. First letter. The lawyer said writing helps. It doesn't. You looked me in the eye when you closed the cuffs. I just wanted to understand why.
O Maciota veio me ver. Trouxe cigarro e: Maciota came to see me. Brought cigarettes and news of you: said you quit the force. I don't know if I was angry or relieved.
Lembra do canal? A gente pulava da muret: Remember the canal? We'd jump off the low wall and Mom would yell from the window. In here I close my eyes and still hear the water.

Aprendi a mexer em motor com um velho da: I learned to work on engines from an old guy in here. He says every car keeps the story of whoever drove it. Our Coyote must be keeping mine.

Contei os dias na parede da cela. Aqui n: I counted the days on my cell wall. Here on the rock too. When I get out, I'm going to the desert: nobody there asks where you came from, only how fast you go.
Saí. Dormi a primeira noite livre num qu: I'm out. Spent my first free night in a roadside room with the light on. Couldn't close the door. Eight years teach you strange things.

Se você leu até aqui, seguiu cada passo: If you've read this far, you've followed every step of mine. So follow one more: the stone table south of the dry riverbed, far from the salt road. The Coyote is still there. It was always ours.
